org: Habitat for Humanity of Glynn County
headline: A website that matches the energy of your social media.
intro: Your story is a strong one: 93 homes, 100+ families and 35 years in Glynn County, and your Facebook and Instagram tell it well. The website hasn't caught up yet. Here's what I found, what a refresh would look like, and what it would cost.
working: A clear headline and real impact numbers
Donation levels that show what each gift funds

findings.title: Template text is showing.
findings.detail: The homepage volunteer section and FAQ answers still contain "Lorem ipsum" placeholder text.

findings.title: Another affiliate's name appears.
findings.detail: The newsletter sign-up mentions "Habitat for Humanity East Central Ohio."

findings.title: ReStore shoppers can't find your hours.
findings.detail: The ReStore page lists none, shows two different unit numbers, and one line is cut off.

findings.title: News has no dates,
findings.detail: so visitors can't tell whether Build Week is coming up or already happened.

findings.title: Volunteering takes an email or phone call.
findings.detail: A simple online sign-up for Wednesday and Saturday build days would fill more spots with less staff time.

images.alt: Concept of a refreshed Habitat for Humanity of Glynn County homepage on a laptop
images.caption: Homepage concept. Donate, volunteer, ReStore and homeownership are each one click away.

images.alt: The same homepage concept on a phone
images.caption: The same page on a phone, where most visitors will see it.

outcome: A homepage where donating, volunteering and finding the ReStore each take one click. Clean, accurate copy throughout, dated news, and an online build-day sign-up. Built on your current WordPress site, so your team keeps editing it the way it does today.
timeline: About 2 weeks from kickoff to launch, once we have your photos and logins.

package.note: Fixes every issue above, redesigned homepage, ReStore page with hours, dated news, online build-day sign-up.

addons.note: Make sure your Google listing shows ReStore hours and gathers reviews.
Updates, backups and an hour of edits each month after launch.
